doc.name: Edge Agents AI
doc.description: Machine-purchasable macro, market and decision intelligence over x402. Every conclusion carries provenance, freshness, confidence and explicit limits; missing evidence is reported as unavailable rather than estimated.

skills.name: Intelligence catalogue discovery
skills.description: Search and browse 808 intelligence services across 17 families, and inspect any service's price, freshness target and output schema before purchase.
examples: Which services cover bitcoin leverage risk?
What does the macro liquidity regime service cost?

skills.name: Free illustrative sampling
skills.description: Return a free illustrative sample of any service's output, so a buyer agent can check the response shape and evidence style before spending anything.
examples: Show me what an XRP structural intelligence report looks like.

skills.name: Paid intelligence reports
skills.description: Purchase specialist reports per request over x402. Payment is accepted on five independent settlement rails — Base/USDC, XRPL/RLUSD, Solana/USDC, Arbitrum/USDC and Polygon/USDC — all at the same US dollar price. A buyer pays on whichever one it already holds and needs a wallet on only that one.
examples: Buy the current business cycle nowcast.
Purchase the BTC leverage and liquidation risk report.

skills.name: Packaged buyer outcomes
skills.description: Composed products that answer one buyer question from several specialist services: XRP Risk Brief, Crypto Market Regime Brief, Trading-Agent Intelligence API, Country Health and Sustainability Brief.
examples: Give me the XRP risk brief.

skills.name: Availability and freshness evidence
skills.description: Report per-service availability and data freshness, so a caller can decide whether the evidence behind a report is current enough for its decision.
examples: Is the ECB money markets service fresh right now?
